name: Farm Machinery Bank (FMB)/Farm Machinery Hub (FMH)
benefit:
> **Pattern Of Assistance:**

  - The subsidy will be 80% of the Total Financial Outlay (TFO) subject to maximum Rs 8.00 lakh and minimum TFO will be ₹10,00,000/-. The TFO includes indicative cost of machinery + Cost of shed +AMC + insurance. The remaining amount of the TFO will be borne by the beneficiary.  
  - The maximum amount allowed for cost of open shed for machinery will be limited to 5%
_eligibility_text: - Individual Rural Youth Entrepreneur registered under Krishak Bandhu (New) Scheme. Or, Groups like SKUS/PACS/FPO/FPC/FIG/SHG duly graded /LAMPS etc approved/recognized by any Govt Institution/Departments . - The Group should be successfully running at least for last 1(one)year are only eligible to setup FMB/FMH in a selected village - The project cost/Total Financial Outlay (TFO) should be minimum ₹10,00,000/-. - The applicant should have sufficient land under his possession (own land/leased/hired) for setting up the FMB/FMH. - The land in question must belong to “commercial or bastu or viti” category. - The age of the beneficiary should be minimum 18 years at the time of application.
